description: This file defines a Summernote plugin called 'databasic' that adds a custom data container feature with UI buttons, dialogs, and popovers for editing and inserting data containers within the Summernote editor.

classes.name: DataBasicPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin class that manages the creation, update, and interaction of the 'Basic Data Container' feature within Summernote.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current data container node at the cursor position.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of a data container node.

methods.name: updateNode
methods.description: Updates the data container node with new data.

methods.name: createNode
methods.description: Creates a new data container node and inserts it into the editor.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays the dialog for editing or inserting a data container.

methods.name: openDialog
methods.description: Handles the dialog interactions and resolves with user input.
